data: What is the Character Error Rate (CER) for Engine 4 at an SNR of 5 dB?

The figure shows CER as a function of SNR for three different engines. The line representing Engine 4 is marked with triangles. At an SNR of 5.0 dB, the CER for Engine 4 is approximately 30%. Therefore, the Character Error Rate (CER) for Engine 4 at an SNR of 5 dB is around 30%.
